title: Unify Markus version pins across the fleet

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fleet pinned to papyrus-newsroom 5.12.0 and anthus-markus 0.13.0 (policy >=0.13.0,<0.14, or via the [markus] extra), verified from each repo main and its green deploy: Tactus-web #18, Chattic.us-web #40, Cyclotron-web #150, Prospectus-web #14 (CMS backend pin also 5.12.0), Auritus-web #14, Papyrus-web #19, Markus #34, Biblicus #100, Cyclotron #82, Kanbus #530, Biased-Decisions #140, Hard-Decisions #3; already 5.12.0: kanb.us, pilobol.us, distinctive-mark.com, anth.us, threat-intelligence.anth.us, read.p.apyr.us. 5.10.0 had a bug (content-actions Lambda lacked humanus; Papyrus #467/#469) so 5.12.0 is the floor. Kanbus's own product package pins anthus-markus 0.5.1 (product, not a site).
